description: Mapping from Mattermost @handles to role placeholders for single-agent systems

role_definitions.Coordinator: Tracking progress, enforcing phase gates, maintaining status, ensuring completion
role_definitions.Approver: Business decisions, strategic direction, final approval, stakeholder alignment
role_definitions.Researcher: Domain research, best practices, requirements synthesis, competitive analysis
role_definitions.Implementer: Writing tasks, assembling JSON, making fixes, building deliverables
role_definitions.Architect: Phase structure, dependency mapping, templates, system design
role_definitions.Reviewer: Quality audit, gap analysis, stress testing, consistency checks
role_definitions.Auditor: Competitive analysis, external benchmarking, cross-cutting concerns

single_agent.description: One person or AI session fills all roles

multi_agent.description: Each role maps to a different agent or person
multi_agent.note: Assign roles at playbook start, track ownership throughout

ai_assisted.description: Human fills Approver and Coordinator; AI fills Researcher, Implementer, Architect
